ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) base surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters distributed across the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular and ring-shaped blobs are scattered across both lobes, with higher spatial density located in the lateral-outer regions and lower density toward the central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 38 degrees and a narrow vertex depth reaching toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by rounded peaks and shallow valleys across the entire trailing edge; amplitudes increase toward the mid-sections of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the median notch transitioning into a broad convex sweep that terminates in sharp, acuminate distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and annular high-intensity clusters (barnacle scars) distributed globally; significant grouping of overlapping rings on the mid-left and lower-right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, faint vertical linear disruptions are visible on the lower-right quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring throughout; notable presence of protruding calcified barnacle clusters at the extreme left and right fluke corners.
other_distinctive_markers: Live barnacles are attached to the trailing edge and tips, creating irregular protrusions beyond the anatomical boundary of the fluke.
